name: Ghoul

actions.name: Claws
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be paralyzed for 1 round. Elves are immune to this paralysis.

actions.name: Bite
actions.effect: Can only target paralyzed, restrained, or prone creatures. The Ghoul heals for half the damage dealt.

actions.name: Pounce
actions.effect: The Ghoul leaps up to 6m and attacks. Target must pass PHYS save or be knocked prone. If the target falls prone, the Ghoul can immediately make a Bite attack as part of this action.

reactions.name: Feral Dodge
reactions.effect: When targeted by an attack, the Ghoul drops to all fours and scrambles. +3 to physical defense against that attack.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The Ghoul has +1d6 to attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the Ghoul's allies is within melee range of the target.

traits.name: Corpse Eater
traits.desc: The Ghoul can consume a corpse as a 2-action activity to heal 5 HP.

lore: Ghouls are ravenous undead driven by an insatiable hunger for humanoid flesh. They hunt in packs through graveyards, battlefields, and underground tunnels, using their paralyzing touch to disable prey before feasting.
